items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I did time with him over at 8. At Camp A.

ctx.x: By the way, you said you knew Ladd Valley went down.
Yes, sir, I did. Where was that? I did time with him over at 8. At Camp A. Yes, sir. 1938. He left here in 1939.
And what did he do? Was he, I mean, doing the work?
